lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg12Zn2Sn2 (reduced formula Mg6ZnSn) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. CrystalNN geometry-only analysis gives all Mg, Sn, and Zn centers a close-packed-like 12-neighbor arrangement, with neighbor distances ranging from about 2.99 to 3.26 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis of the 12-vertex coordination polyhedra shows Mg–Mg polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, and Mg–Sn and Mg–Zn polyhedra sharing corners and edges.
